summary.zh-CN: 面向 DSH Agent 会话的项目需求追溯、分阶段执行、人工审核与交付看板。
summary.en-US: Project traceability, staged agent execution, human review, and delivery workflow for DSH sessions.

network: Local DSH web profile HTTP route prefix /taskboard only
filesystem: Read/write taskboard data file (default package-local datas/boards.json, overridable via DSH_TASKBOARD_DATA)
Create/remove isolated per-task Git worktrees under the taskboard runtime data directory
Update a registered workspace only during serialized final integration; preserve source branches when integration conflicts
process: Run git with explicit argument arrays under registered workspaces and task-owned worktrees (worktree, status, add, commit, rebase, merge, branch, rev-parse and cleanup)
